title: Chess, But I Can't Break the Laws of Islam
summary: A normal game vs Martin played under self-imposed rules Tony derives from Islamic principles (inspired by a Minecraft video): no resigning, only plain chess (spell/potion variants ruled out as magic/intoxicants), profess the Shahada in chat before move 1, type 'Bismillah Allahu Akbar' before capturing a knight (the only 'livestock'), and give back 25% of material gained (sadaqa, rounded up) to Martin before mating. He gains ~22-30 points, sacrifices the queen back (Qd8, 9 points) and mates with Re8 (~5:23), then types as-salamu alaykum and paints Martin a portrait.
rules: Standard chess vs Martin; no variant pieces/spells.
Before the first move, a chat message (profession of faith) is typed.
Before capturing an enemy knight, a chat phrase ('Bismillah Allahu Akbar') is typed first.

Material-gain counter: before delivering checkmate the player must have sacrificed back at least 25% (rounded up) of the material advantage gained (e.g. 22 gained -> give back >=6; he gave back 9 with Qd8).
After the win, a peace message is typed in chat.
win_condition: Checkmate Martin after having given back >=25% of gained material, without resigning.

board.theme_notes: standard chess.com green; edit overlays: 'Sadaqah' parchment card, crossed-out spell icons (freeze spell, potion, bottle), Quran verse captions (Al-Ma'idah 5:90, Al-Baqarah 2:102)

events: Chat prompt before first move and before each knight capture
Give-back requirement shown as material counter next to username
current_impl_issues: Impl maps it to Shatranj (ancient Islamic chess with ferz/elephants); the video is plain modern chess with self-imposed behavioural rules.
Missing material give-back requirement and no-resign rule.
evidence: 0:22-1:15 rules 1-2 (no resign, normal chess, spells forbidden); 1:15-1:22 Shahada in chat; 2:04-2:48 zakat 2.5% raised to 25% 'before we give him checkmate'; 3:30-3:44 knight capture phrase; 4:09 'accumulated 22 points... give back at least six'; 5:15 Qd8 sacrifice; 5:23 Re8 mate.
